title: AIGovern-Cyber POC008: Evidence-Bound Continuity
description: A bounded Rust continuity experiment combining the actual source-derived ESS-MAI PD core/detector/checkpoint/data types, restricted operational PDC1 contract, PdProjection and supporting primitives with a new Store/WAL adapter. Local validation comprises 35 passing tests: 20 retained source unit tests and 15 integration tests, with no failures or ignored tests. Five-turn and 65-turn experiments compare exact checkpoint bytes at every step between uninterrupted execution and fresh-process continuation. Tests cover retries, stale heads, scoped contexts, corrupted records and partial headers, incomplete tails, competing file owners and oversized input. A valid older WAL is accepted and remains an explicit rollback limitation. The adapter is not the original KnowledgeVault or WAL-compatible with it. The auxiliary PDC1 field is not evaluated. Maximum format bounds are 4096 turns and an 8 MiB checkpoint; no full-horizon or indefinite-continuity proof is claimed. Records pin exact adapter-source bytes and migration is absent. Every open replays the full WAL; inspect can initialize or repair files. No authenticated rollback prevention, universal power-loss guarantee, hostile-host proof, science-query evaluation, native knowledge verdict, certification or AI Act compliance is claimed. OpenAI Codex assisted engineering and documentation; Bledar Gjata directs the architecture and reports shell-based review. The Windows GNU run used Rust/Cargo 1.98.0; exact commands and artifact identity are recorded in evidence/RESULT.json. External CI and independent review are separate activities.
